flagged_clauses.heading: INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY AND WORK PRODUCT
flagged_clauses.rationale: Assigns pre-existing IP and ideas developed prior to the agreement; perpetual moral rights waiver.
flagged_clauses.counterparty_question: Can we carve out pre-existing intellectual property and restrict assignment to custom deliverables created under this scope?

flagged_clauses.heading: INDEMNIFICATION
flagged_clauses.rationale: One-way uncapped indemnification of the company with no reciprocal protection for the contractor.
flagged_clauses.counterparty_question: Can the indemnification be made mutual and capped to the total fees paid under this agreement?

flagged_clauses.heading: RESTRICTIVE COVENANTS
flagged_clauses.rationale: 18-month worldwide non-compete preventing freelance work across marketing/software sectors.
flagged_clauses.counterparty_question: Can this non-compete clause be struck or narrowed solely to direct solicitation of your current active clients?

flagged_clauses.heading: TERMINATION
flagged_clauses.rationale: Asymmetric termination rights (company can terminate immediately, contractor requires 60 days) plus forfeiture of pending invoices.
flagged_clauses.counterparty_question: Can both parties have 30 days notice to terminate for convenience, with full payment for all work performed to date?

flagged_clauses.heading: FEES AND AUTOMATIC RENEWAL
flagged_clauses.rationale: Auto-renewal with right to increase fees up to 25% without prior notice.
flagged_clauses.counterparty_question: Can you provide at least 60 days written notice before renewal if prices increase, with right to opt out?

flagged_clauses.heading: UNILATERAL MODIFICATION OF TERMS
flagged_clauses.rationale: Provider can unilaterally alter terms, SLA, and pricing at any time with continued use deemed acceptance.
flagged_clauses.counterparty_question: Can terms and pricing changes require mutual written consent or allow 30 days penalty-free exit?

flagged_clauses.heading: LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
flagged_clauses.rationale: Provider liability capped at $0 while subscriber liability remains completely uncapped.
flagged_clauses.counterparty_question: Can we establish a mutual aggregate liability cap equal to 12 months of subscription fees paid?

flagged_clauses.heading: DISPUTE RESOLUTION AND MANDATORY ARBITRATION
flagged_clauses.rationale: Mandatory binding arbitration in Delaware with waiver of jury trial and class action.
flagged_clauses.counterparty_question: Can disputes be subject to mutual executive escalation and standard court jurisdiction?

flagged_clauses.heading: OPERATING EXPENSES AND CAPITAL PASS-THROUGHS
flagged_clauses.rationale: Uncapped pass-through of structural replacements and capital modernization at landlord sole discretion.
flagged_clauses.counterparty_question: Can capital expenditures be excluded from operating expenses or amortized over their useful life with an annual percentage cap?

flagged_clauses.heading: EARLY TERMINATION PENALTY
flagged_clauses.rationale: Accelerates all remaining lease payments as liquidated damages upon early departure.
flagged_clauses.counterparty_question: Can the early termination fee be capped at 3 months rent, subject to reasonable advance notice?

flagged_clauses.heading: LANDLORD ACCESS AND ENTRY
flagged_clauses.rationale: Landlord entry at any hour without notice or tenant accompaniment.
flagged_clauses.counterparty_question: Can landlord entry be conditioned on 24 hours advance written notice, except in bona fide emergencies?

flagged_clauses.heading: CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION
flagged_clauses.rationale: Shifts burden of proof with clear and convincing standard to exclude publicly known information.
flagged_clauses.counterparty_question: Can standard exclusions apply based on general commercial availability without heightened evidentiary burdens?

flagged_clauses.heading: DURATION AND POST-TERM RESTRICTIONS
flagged_clauses.rationale: Perpetual confidentiality obligation combined with a 2-year broad customer and personnel non-solicitation.
flagged_clauses.counterparty_question: Can confidentiality be limited to 2-3 years, and the non-solicit restricted to key personnel directly engaged in discussions?

flagged_clauses.heading: REMEDIES AND LEGAL EXPENSES
flagged_clauses.rationale: One-sided fee shifting forcing receiving party to pay legal fees regardless of outcome.
flagged_clauses.counterparty_question: Can fee recovery follow the standard prevailing party rule, rather than unconditional payment by one side?

contracts.note: Negative control contract: balanced mutual terms, capped liability, mutual indemnity. Should produce 0 high-risk flags.
